# Reading references

These are supporting references for the learning project. Read selected sections when they help with the current question.

## Mathematical foundations

Marc Peter Deisenroth, A. Aldo Faisal, and Cheng Soon Ong, *Mathematics for Machine Learning*. The authors provide a free PDF. Chapter 5 covers vector calculus; later chapters cover probability and optimization.

<https://mml-book.github.io/>

## Computational graphs and backpropagation

*Dive into Deep Learning*, section 5.3, "Forward Propagation, Backward Propagation, and Computational Graphs."

<https://d2l.ai/chapter_multilayer-perceptrons/backprop.html>

## Automatic differentiation

*Dive into Deep Learning*, section 2.5, "Automatic Differentiation."

<https://d2l.ai/chapter_preliminaries/autograd.html>

The official PyTorch tutorial, "Automatic Differentiation with torch.autograd," connects computational graphs to framework behavior.

<https://docs.pytorch.org/tutorials/beginner/basics/autogradqs_tutorial.html>

## A later architectural reference

Qwen3.5-27B was discussed as an example of a modern model combining mechanisms beyond a conventional transformer. The exact model for a later unit has not been selected.

<https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.5-27B>
